texts.zh:
在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上的一个广袤而与世隔绝的山谷中发现了一些不同物种的化石，这些物种似乎不是属于[Root.GetName]的。它们大体上都来自大约360万年前的同一个时期，时间跨度在几个世纪内。

每个物种似乎都是在其所属的独特的生物圈中进化而来的，而且它们似乎都具有智慧。奇怪的是，到目前为止发现的每个化石都显示出因暴力遇害的迹象。
texts.en:
Fossilized remains from several different species that do not appear to have been indigenous to [Root.GetName] have been found in a large and secluded valley on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. They all date from roughly the same time period, within the span of a few centuries some 3.6 million years ago.

Each of these species seems to have evolved in its own unique biosphere, and all appear to have been sapient. Strangely, every fossilized individual found so far shows signs of having met a violent end.
